title: Per-tape space is at most total space
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration, $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and $i$ a work-tape index. The number of distinct cells visited by tape $i$ through step $t$ is at most the total space used through step $t$.
replaced:
For every multi-tape Turing machine $M$, configuration $c$, step count $t$,
and work-tape index $i$, the number of cells touched by the head of tape $i$
up to step $t$ is at most the total space used by $M$ from $c$ up to step $t$.
